topic: Theory breakdown: Kaido's dragon form was the strongest-looking move, not the strongest move in his fight with Luffy
title: Why Kaido's Dragon Form Was Never Really the Strongest Move
description:
Kaido's dragon form gets called his strongest move, but I argue its size, scales and fire made it the wrong tool for the duel he actually fought with Luffy on Onigashima. This breakdown walks through the fight, the hybrid form that kept his skills, and the Gear 5 comeback that followed.

Was the dragon his best move, or only his most visible one? Tell me where you land in the comments.

2:30 Why Luffy Kept Getting Back Up
5:20 The Hit Nobody Could Block
8:30 Why the Dragon Was a Trap
11:20 The Verdict Nobody Likes
13:45 Where the Trap Closed
